name: 🍖 Mighty Meatloaf
tagline: Tender, glazed meatloaf with broccoli and rice. Two loaves, so there's lunch tomorrow.

items.name: Ketchup (half in, half for the glaze)
Salt, pepper, garlic powder, olive oil

steps.text: Oven to 375°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
In a big bowl stir the panko and milk; let it soak 2 minutes. Add eggs, grated onion, ½ cup ketchup, Worcestershire, 1½ tsp salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Add the meat and mix gently with clean hands just until combined. Don't squeeze it.
Shape two loaves about 8×4 inches on the pan.
Stir ⅓ cup ketchup with the brown sugar; brush half on the loaves. Bake 35 minutes.
Brush on the rest of the glaze, add the broccoli tossed with oil and salt to the pan, and bake until the meat hits 160°F.
Make the rice while it bakes. Rest the meatloaf 10 minutes before slicing.

kid_jobs.job: Crack the eggs into a cup first (fish out shells)
Squish the meatloaf mix (wash hands before and after)
Paint on the glaze with a brush

chef_tip: Soak the crumbs in milk first and mix the meat as little as you can. That's what makes meatloaf tender instead of a brick.
make_ahead: Shape the loaves in the morning, cover and refrigerate; add 5 minutes to the bake.
leftovers: Cold meatloaf sandwiches on sandwich bread with ketchup: a lunchbox classic.
swaps: Ground beef or ground turkey for the meatloaf mix
serve_with: Broccoli and rice (in the recipe), or green beans

game_plan.what: Oven to 375°F. Panko soaking in milk.
Kids mix the meatloaf gently and shape two loaves.
First glaze on; loaves into the oven.
Second glaze; broccoli onto the pan. Rice on.
Meatloaf out to rest. Fluff the rice.
Slice and serve with broccoli and rice.
